commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot and add Level-0 greeting
commitResults.messageBody:
Rename the entry point and visible branding so the application
consistently identifies itself as Chatty. Print a structured greeting
and farewell to establish the Level-0 interaction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add command echo and bye handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep reading user input so Chatty can echo commands instead of exiting
after its greeting. Handle bye separately to end the conversation with a
clear farewell.

Store task descriptions during each Chatty session so users can build
a simple list without persistence. Number tasks in insertion order when
the list command is entered.

Represent each task as an object so its description and completion
status stay together. Support listing, marking, and unmarking tasks, and
document the commands in the user guide.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add todo deadline and event tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Parse the three Level-4 task formats while preserving date and time
values as user-entered text. Display task type icons, timing details, and
the updated task count, and document each command.

Move type-specific display data into Todo, Deadline, and Event
subclasses. Keep common status behavior in Task and use polymorphism so
the task list does not need type-specific branching.

Use a Chatty-specific checked exception to report malformed task
commands, missing values, invalid indexes, and unknown input without
terminating the conversation. Document how Chatty responds to errors.

Remove a task selected by its displayed number and report the removed
task and remaining count. Reuse validated task lookup so malformed or
out-of-range delete commands do not terminate Chatty.

Represent Chatty commands as a closed set of enum values so dispatch no
longer depends on a long chain of repeated string comparisons. Preserve
the existing distinction between commands with and without arguments.
Write the task list after every successful mutation so progress is not lost when Chatty exits. Use a relative, platform-independent data path and create its parent directory when needed.
Restore each task type and its completion state when Chatty starts. Treat missing or blank data as an empty list and report malformed records instead of terminating unexpectedly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-7 for persistent task storage
commitResults.messageBody: Keep the Level 7 work on its required feature branch while integrating the verified save and startup-loading behavior into master.
Validate ISO dates at command and storage boundaries so malformed or impossible dates cannot enter the task list. Preserve ISO values on disk while showing users a more readable English date.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-8 for structured deadline dates
commitResults.messageBody: Keep the Level 8 increment on its required feature branch while integrating the verified LocalDate parsing, persistence, and display behavior into master.

Move input reading and response formatting out of Chatty so application orchestration no longer depends directly on Scanner or System.out. Preserve the existing command-line output exactly to avoid user-visible regressions.

Move command recognition, task construction, date validation, and task-number parsing out of Chatty. This keeps syntactic input concerns together while leaving orchestration responsible only for dispatch and persistence.

Give the task collection responsibility for indexed lookup and mutations, and turn Chatty into an instance-based coordinator for Ui, Parser, Storage, and TaskList. This prevents orchestration code from modifying the underlying list directly.
Integrate the verified Ui, Parser, Storage, and TaskList separation while preserving Chatty's existing command behavior and persisted data format.

Keep src/main/java as the source root while grouping application, parser, storage, task, UI, and exception responsibilities under the chatty namespace. This makes ownership and dependencies clearer without changing command behavior or the persisted data format.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-Packages for Java package organization
commitResults.messageBody: Integrate the verified chatty package hierarchy while retaining src/main/java as the source root and preserving the existing CLI and storage behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge add-gradle-support for Gradle build tooling

commitResults.messageBody: Point the application plugin at the packaged chatty.Chatty main class so Gradle can build and run the chatbot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for core task behavior
commitResults.messageBody: Cover command parsing, task-list mutations, and storage round-trips so regressions in Chatty's highest-value logic are caught by the Gradle test task.
Configure the Shadow output as Chatty.jar so the distributable matches the application while remaining generated and excluded from version control.

Several APIs and internal helpers have only brief headers without complete parameter, return, and exception contracts.

Document all non-private members, non-trivial private helpers, and tests so generated API documentation explains behavior consistently.

Switch labels and fall-through paths do not follow the prescribed layout, and Javadoc parameter descriptions are inconsistently punctuated.

Align switch blocks, mark intentional fall-through, and standardize parameter documentation so future code has a clear style baseline.

The JavaDoc and coding-standard branches edit overlapping comments and switch blocks from the same base.

Preserve the complete API contracts from A-JavaDoc while applying the SE-EDU switch layout and explicit fall-through markers.

Users can list every task but cannot narrow a growing list by description.

Add a validated find command that searches descriptions without changing stored data, displays matches in list order, and documents and tests the flow.
